Careers
CAREERS AT ORANGE LOGIC
Join Orange Logic to solve complex problems across enterprise software, AI, and customer workflows with ownership of work customers depend on.
 SEE OPEN POSITIONS
What we do
We help some of the world’s biggest enterprises achieve their objectives by helping them with their digital asset management needs. In other words, we work hard to bring order to digital chaos, and we’ve recruited dedicated employees worldwide to help us do that.
 EXPLORE ORANGE DAM
What it’s like to work
at Orange Logic
At Orange Logic, you’ll solve complex problems for organizations that depend on our software every day. Whether you’re building the product, helping a customer, or improving how we operate, you’ll see how your work contributes to something bigger.
Ownership matters here. You’ll have room to bring ideas, make decisions, and take work from an initial challenge to a meaningful result. We value people who ask thoughtful questions, explore better approaches, and follow through. As our platform and company evolve, there are new problems to solve and opportunities to expand your skills.
We hold ourselves to high standards and believe collaboration makes our work stronger. That means sharing expertise, giving honest feedback, and raising concerns early. You don’t need to have every answer, but you should be willing to seek input, challenge assumptions, and learn as you go.
Above all, we care about the work and the people behind it: our customers, our colleagues, and the teams who rely on what we build. If you enjoy meaningful responsibility, thoughtful collaboration, and seeing the impact of your contributions, we’d love to meet you.

Who we’re looking for
We’re a growing company, and each of our employees has a lasting impact. We’re looking for individuals who are up for a challenge and can thrive in a fast-paced environment. You might be right for Orange Logic if you’re an expert in your field and if you enjoy the freedom to develop your own solutions to problems. Most importantly, we’re looking to hire people who care — about our customers, about our product, and about each other.

How we lift each other up
At Orange Logic we celebrate our differences. They provide new perspectives and offer benefits to our employees, our digital asset management product, and our customers. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, or any other protected class.
Orange Logic is an E-Verify Employer. For more information regarding E-Verify, please click here. For information regarding your Right To Work, please click here.
Perks and benefits
Competitive Salary. We aim to attract the best team possible, so we pay you what you’re worth.
Health. Generous medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Paid parental leave.
Room to grow. A high-growth environment in the digital asset management industry.
401k Matching. 4% company match to your base salary (U.S. region).
